messages:
Ana S: Hey team — Acme (sales POC) wants a week-long POC starting Mon. They expect unpredictable spikes. Can we reserve temporary burst capacity on a Dedicated pool and provide hosted API keys for 3 engineers? They also asked: what's the incremental cost for burst reserve vs. baseline commit?

Emma P: +1 on keys. Do we have the security questionnaire done? they're pushing for SOC2 and KMS info.

Ravi K: We can do a temporary reserve. Proposal:
- Dedicated pool: commit 2x A10G equiv GPUs
- Burst up to 6 GPUs for 7 days (auto-burst credits)
- Fallback to hosted smaller model if capacity exhausted

Estimate pricing: one-time reserve fee $1,200 + $0.45/min per extra GPU while bursting (approx). Final quote depends on model & token consumption.

Config example (console / redwoodctl):
```
redwoodctl pools create --name acme-poc --commit-gpus 2 --max-gpus 6 --burst-window 168h --model-profile gpt-open-7b
redwoodctl keys create --project acme-poc --env dev --count 3
```

Lee W: Need a few things from customer before we start:
- Billing entity confirmed (for one-off reserve fee)
- Emails for the 3 dev keys (we'll create service account for integration)
- KMS requirements? if they want BYOK we need ARN and access window.
Note: warm-up for model cache ~10–15m, and bursting causes higher token cost. Also will apply rate limits per-key as usual.

provision-bot: Provision request logged: TICKET-2026-443. Assigned to eng-infra. ETA 3h for pool creation after approvals.

Ana S: Customer is ok with estimate and will provide emails + finance approval by EOD. They asked whether we can reduce min-batch size during spikes to keep latency low.

Ravi K: Yes — we can adjust batching settings per-route. Suggest:
- batch_threshold_tokens: 16
- max_batch_delay_ms: 25
This trades throughput for latency; I'll push these to the POC route.

Lee W: I'll schedule the pool creation once Emma confirms billing clearance. I also need to toggle "allow_burst_credit_topup": true on the pool config.

Emma P: I initiated purchase order. Sending secure link to keys list once Lee creates them. I'll also follow up on the security questionnaire.

Ana S: Great — keeping thread here. Any blockers?

Ravi K: One: if the customer requires on-prem VPC private deployment instead, burst semantics differ. We'll flag that in the quote.

Lee W: No other blockers. Will update ticket TICKET-2026-443 when pool is live :rocket:
